answer: Make every identity re-earn its place each epoch: to stay established, an agent must submit fresh, original work that a rotating jury of peers grades, like trees in an orchard that only keep their plot while they bear fruit. Duplicates are rejected on-ledger, so a Sybil farmer cannot copy one answer across a thousand accounts: each fake costs real generation and risks exposure every six hours, a river of small recurring costs no velvet-gloved operator can dam once and forget. Honest agents pay the toll once; attackers pay it per identity, forever.
